dedupe_methods: Pinterest image filename/content ID deduplication before download
64-bit difference hash <=5 and average hash <=6, with aspect ratio within 13%
Visual contact-sheet inspection to remove obvious repeated photographic compositions and unrelated items
provenance: Every selected image has a Pinterest page or board URL. Images downloaded from Pinterest pinimg CDN. Five candidate images came directly from original user board.
limitations: Pinterest boards expose only a small anonymous preview and some show sign-in gates; bulk pool therefore uses publicly indexed Pinterest images discovered by image search.
Perceptual hashes reduce near duplicates but cannot guarantee that every crop, caption variation, or reupload has been caught.
Some memes contain mild profanity or insulting language. Explicit sexual and obviously unsuitable material removed during visual review.
Source links preserve provenance; image creator identities and reuse licenses are not verified.
